verdicts.reason: A: the headline and body fill the card well, but the '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' eyebrow has moved to the bottom row after the CTA, so the reading order is broken. The Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk until it is unreadable, the legal text is microscopic, and the book overlaps the card edge awkwardly. B has the same scrambled bottom row (CTA, tiny logo, eyebrow, legal), but its headline is smaller with dead space above it, the bottom-row text is even fainter and smaller, and the book is pushed against the left edge and clipped by the card, so the whole layout feels weaker and more like a shrunk copy.
